local function HasLineOfSight(origin, targetPart, character)
    local cam = GetCamera()
    if not cam then return true end

    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType  = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.IgnoreWater = true

    local filter = { cam }
    if LocalPlayer.Character then
        table.insert(filter, LocalPlayer.Character)
    end
    local we = Workspace:FindFirstChild("WeaponEffects")
    if we then table.insert(filter, we) end

    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = filter

    local hit = Workspace:Raycast(origin, targetPart.Position - origin, params)
    if not hit then return true end
    return hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(character)
end

local function IsOnScreen(worldPos)
    local cam = GetCamera()
    if not cam then return false end
    local screenPos, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(worldPos)
    if not onScreen then return false end
    if screenPos.Z <= 0 then return false end
    return true
end

local function ConsiderTarget(origin, lookUnit, character, targetPart, best)
    if not targetPart then return best end

    if CONFIG.AliveCheck then
        local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return best end
    end

    if not CONFIG.IgnoreForceField then
        if character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then return best end
    end

    local dir  = targetPart.Position - origin
    local dist = dir.Magnitude

    if dist <= 0.1 or dist > CONFIG.FOV then return best end

    local angle = math.acos(math.clamp(lookUnit:Dot(dir.Unit), -1, 1))

    if not CONFIG.FullCircle then
        if angle >= math.rad(CONFIG.AimCone) then return best end
        if CONFIG.OnScreenCheck and not IsOnScreen(targetPart.Position) then return best end
    end

    if CONFIG.VisibleCheck and not HasLineOfSight(origin, targetPart, character) then return best end

    local score
    if CONFIG.FullCircle then
        score = dist
    else
        score = angle * 10 + dist * 0.01
    end

    if not best or score < best.score then
        return { part = targetPart, score = score }
    end
    return best
end

local function GatherBots()
    local seen = {}
    local out  = {}

    local function add(m)
        if not m or seen[m] then return end
        if not m:IsA("Model") then return end
        if m:HasTag("RagdollRig") then return end
        if not m:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then return end
        seen[m] = true
        table.insert(out, m)
    end

    for _, v in CollectionService:GetTagged("Bot") do add(v) end
    for _, v in CollectionService:GetTagged("NPC") do add(v) end

    for _, v in Workspace:GetDescendants() do
        if v:IsA("Model") and v:GetAttribute("IsBot") == true then
            add(v)
        end
    end

    return out
end

local function GetBestTarget(origin, lookUnit)
    local best = nil

    if CONFIG.TargetPlayers then
        for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
            if IsEnemyPlayer(player) then
                local char = player.Character
                if char then
                    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
                    local hrp  = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    local part = (CONFIG.TargetHead and head) or hrp
                    best = ConsiderTarget(origin, lookUnit, char, part, best)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if CONFIG.TargetBots then
        for _, bot in GatherBots() do
            if IsEnemyBot(bot) then
                local head  = bot:FindFirstChild("Head")
                local hrp   = bot:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local torso = bot:FindFirstChild("Torso") or bot:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
                local part  = (CONFIG.TargetHead and head) or hrp or torso
                best = ConsiderTarget(origin, lookUnit, bot, part, best)
            end
        end
    end

    return best and best.part or nil
end

local originalApply = AimAssist.ApplyBulletMagnetism

AimAssist.ApplyBulletMagnetism = function(origin, direction, isAiming)
    if not SilentAimEnabled then
        return originalApply(origin, direction, isAiming)
    end

    local magnitude = direction.Magnitude
    if magnitude <= 0 then return direction end

    local target = GetBestTarget(origin, direction.Unit)
    if not target then
        return originalApply(origin, direction, isAiming)
    end

    local toTarget = target.Position - origin
    if toTarget.Magnitude <= 0.001 then
        return direction
    end

    return toTarget.Unit * magnitude
end

local originalFireRequestSend = Packets.Combat.FireRequest.send

Packets.Combat.FireRequest.send = function(payload)
    if SilentAimEnabled and payload and payload.Origin and payload.Direction then
        local magnitude = payload.Direction.Magnitude
        if magnitude > 0 then
            local target = GetBestTarget(payload.Origin, payload.Direction.Unit)
            if target then
                payload = {
                    ShotId    = payload.ShotId,
                    Origin    = payload.Origin,
                    Direction = (target.Position - payload.Origin).Unit * magnitude,
                    FireTime  = payload.FireTime,
                }
            end
        end
    end
    return originalFireRequestSend(payload)
end

local function TriggerbotStep()
    if not TriggerbotEnabled or not SilentAimEnabled then return end
    if not WeaponState.CurrentConfig then return end
    if os.clock() < WeaponState.FirstTimeEquipUntil then return end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end

    if WeaponState.CurrentAmmo <= CONFIG.AutoReloadThreshold
        and not WeaponState.IsReloading then

        local now = os.clock()
        if now - lastAutoReloadAttempt >= CONFIG.AutoReloadCooldown then
            lastAutoReloadAttempt = now
            if WeaponController and WeaponController.Reload then
                pcall(function()
                    WeaponController:Reload()
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    if WeaponState.IsReloading then return end
    if WeaponState.CurrentAmmo <= CONFIG.AutoReloadThreshold then return end

    if CONFIG.TriggerbotRequireLMB
        and not UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
        return
    end

    local now = os.clock()
    if now - lastTriggerFire < CONFIG.TriggerbotMinDelay then return end

    local cam = GetCamera()
    if not cam then return end

    local origin = cam.CFrame.Position
    local look   = cam.CFrame.LookVector

    local target = GetBestTarget(origin, look)
    if not target then return end

    lastTriggerFire = now
    PrimeFire()
end

		return (camera.CFrame.Position - position).Magnitude
	end

	return nil
end

local function readState(model, spec)
	if not spec.StateAttribute then
		return nil
	end

	local ok, value = pcall(function()
		return model:GetAttribute(spec.StateAttribute)
	end)

	if ok and value ~= nil then
		return tostring(value)
	end

	return nil
end

local function isChasingState(state, spec)
	if not state then
		return false
	end

	local upper = string.upper(state)
	for chaseState in pairs(spec.ChaseStates) do
		if upper == string.upper(chaseState) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

local function buildArrow(color)
	local arrow = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	arrow.Name = "espArrow"
	arrow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	arrow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(64, 64)
	arrow.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	arrow.TextSize = 46
	arrow.TextColor3 = color
	arrow.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	arrow.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	arrow.Text = arrowGlyph
	arrow.Visible = false
	arrow.Parent = playerGui
	return arrow
end

local function updateArrow(arrow, position, color)
	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then
		return
	end

	local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
	if viewport.X <= 0 or viewport.Y <= 0 then
		return
	end

	local screenPoint, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(position)

	if onScreen and screenPoint.Z > 0 then
		local clampedX = math.clamp(screenPoint.X, 48, viewport.X - 48)
		local clampedY = math.clamp(screenPoint.Y, 48, viewport.Y - 48)

		if clampedX == screenPoint.X and clampedY == screenPoint.Y then
			arrow.Visible = false
			return
		end

		arrow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(clampedX, clampedY)
	else
		local relative = camera.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
		local flat = Vector2.new(relative.X, relative.Y)

		if flat.Magnitude < 1e-4 then
			flat = Vector2.new(0, 1)
		else
			flat = flat.Unit
		end

		if relative.Z > 0 then
			flat = -flat
		end

		local halfX = viewport.X / 2
		local halfY = viewport.Y / 2
		local scale = math.min(
			halfX / math.max(math.abs(flat.X), 1e-4),
			halfY / math.max(math.abs(flat.Y), 1e-4)
		)

		local projectedX = halfX + flat.X * scale
		local projectedY = halfY - flat.Y * scale

		arrow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
			math.clamp(projectedX, 48, viewport.X - 48),
			math.clamp(projectedY, 48, viewport.Y - 48)
		)
	end

	arrow.TextColor3 = color
	arrow.Visible = true
end

local function buildKeyEsp(model)
	if getKeyPosition(model) == nil then
		return nil
	end

	local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
	highlight.Name = "keyEspHighlight"
	highlight.Adornee = model
	highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
	highlight.FillColor = keyColor
	highlight.FillTransparency = 0.65
	highlight.OutlineColor = keyColor
	highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
	highlight.Parent = model

	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "keyEspLabel"
	gui.Adornee = model
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	gui.LightInfluence = 0
	gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 22)
	gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 1.6, 0)
	gui.MaxDistance = maxDrawDistance
	gui.Parent = model

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = "Text"
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.TextSize = 14
	label.TextColor3 = keyLabelColor
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	label.Text = "KEY"
	label.Parent = gui

	return {
		Model = model,
		Highlight = highlight,
		Gui = gui,
		Label = label,
		Arrow = buildArrow(keyColor),
	}
end

local function buildMonsterEsp(model, spec)
	if getMonsterPosition(model, spec.AnchorParts) == nil then
		return nil
	end

	local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
	highlight.Name = "monsterEspHighlight"
	highlight.Adornee = model
	highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
	highlight.FillColor = spec.Color
	highlight.FillTransparency = 0.85
	highlight.OutlineColor = spec.Color
	highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
	highlight.Parent = model

	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "monsterEspLabel"
	gui.Adornee = model
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	gui.LightInfluence = 0
	gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(190, 40)
	gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 3.4, 0)
	gui.MaxDistance = maxDrawDistance
	gui.Parent = model

	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Name = "Title"
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.6, 0)
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	title.TextSize = 17
	title.TextColor3 = spec.Color
	title.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	title.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	title.Text = spec.Name
	title.Parent = gui

	local subtitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	subtitle.Name = "Subtitle"
	subtitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	subtitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.58, 0)
	subtitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.42, 0)
	subtitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	subtitle.TextSize = 13
	subtitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 235, 235)
	subtitle.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	subtitle.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	subtitle.Text = ""
	subtitle.Parent = gui

	return {
		Model = model,
		Spec = spec,
		Highlight = highlight,
		Gui = gui,
		Title = title,
		Subtitle = subtitle,
		Arrow = buildArrow(spec.Color),
	}
end

local function destroyEntry(entry)
	for _, inst in ipairs({ entry.Highlight, entry.Gui, entry.Arrow }) do
		if inst then
			inst:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

local function collectKeys()
	local found = {}

	for _, source in ipairs(keySources) do
		local container = walkPath(Workspace, source)
		if container then
			for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
				local key = child:FindFirstChild("Key")
				if key and key:IsA("Model") then
					table.insert(found, key)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return found
end

local function collectMonsters()
	local found = {}

	for _, spec in ipairs(monsterList) do
		local model = walkPath(Workspace, spec.Path)
		if model and model.Parent then
			local position = getMonsterPosition(model, spec.AnchorParts)
			if position and position.Y > minActiveHeight then
				table.insert(found, { Model = model, Spec = spec })
			end
		end
	end

	return found
end

local function syncEsp()
	if unloaded then
		return
	end

	local liveKeys = {}
	for _, model in ipairs(collectKeys()) do
		liveKeys[model] = true
		if not keyModels[model] then
			local ok, entry = pcall(buildKeyEsp, model)
			if ok and entry then
				keyModels[model] = entry
			end
		end
	end

	for model, entry in pairs(keyModels) do
		if not liveKeys[model] or not model.Parent then
			destroyEntry(entry)
			keyModels[model] = nil
		end
	end

	local liveMonsters = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(collectMonsters()) do
		liveMonsters[item.Model] = item.Spec
		if not monsterModels[item.Model] then
			local ok, entry = pcall(buildMonsterEsp, item.Model, item.Spec)
			if ok and entry then
				monsterModels[item.Model] = entry
			end
		end
	end

	for model, entry in pairs(monsterModels) do
		if not liveMonsters[model] or not model.Parent then
			destroyEntry(entry)
			monsterModels[model] = nil
		end
	end
end

local function updateKeyEsp(entry)
	local position = getKeyPosition(entry.Model)
	if position == nil then
		return
	end

	local distance = distanceFromPlayer(position)
	if distance then
		entry.Label.Text = "KEY  " .. tostring(math.floor(distance + 0.5)) .. "m"
	end

	if entry.Arrow then
		updateArrow(entry.Arrow, position, keyColor)
	end
end

local function updateMonsterEsp(entry)
	local position = getMonsterPosition(entry.Model, entry.Spec.AnchorParts)
	if position == nil then
		return
	end

	local distance = distanceFromPlayer(position)
	local state = readState(entry.Model, entry.Spec)
	local chasing = isChasingState(state, entry.Spec)
	local close = distance ~= nil and distance <= monitorDistance

	local color = entry.Spec.Color
	if close then
		color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
	elseif chasing then
		color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 0)
	end

	entry.Highlight.OutlineColor = color
	entry.Highlight.FillColor = color
	entry.Highlight.FillTransparency = close and 0.7 or 0.85
	entry.Title.TextColor3 = color
	entry.Title.Text = close and (entry.Spec.Name .. "  !!") or entry.Spec.Name

	local info = {}
	if state then
		table.insert(info, string.upper(state))
	end
	if distance then
		table.insert(info, tostring(math.floor(distance + 0.5)) .. "m")
	end
	if close then
		table.insert(info, "CLOSE")
	end
	entry.Subtitle.Text = table.concat(info, "  ")

	if entry.Arrow then
		updateArrow(entry.Arrow, position, color)
	end
end

local function setEspVisible(visible)
	espOn = visible

	for _, entry in pairs(keyModels) do
		entry.Highlight.Enabled = visible
		entry.Gui.Enabled = visible
		if not visible and entry.Arrow then
			entry.Arrow.Visible = false
		end
	end

	for _, entry in pairs(monsterModels) do
		entry.Highlight.Enabled = visible
		entry.Gui.Enabled = visible
		if not visible and entry.Arrow then
			entry.Arrow.Visible = false
		end
	end
end

local function unloadEsp()
	if unloaded then
		return
	end

	unloaded = true
	espOn = false

	for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(connections)

	for model, entry in pairs(keyModels) do
		destroyEntry(entry)
		keyModels[model] = nil
	end

	for model, entry in pairs(monsterModels) do
		destroyEntry(entry)
		monsterModels[model] = nil
	end
end

table.insert(connections, Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function()
	task.defer(syncEsp)
end))

table.insert(connections, Workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function()
	task.defer(syncEsp)
end))

table.insert(connections, RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if unloaded then
		return
	end

	for model, entry in pairs(keyModels) do
		if model.Parent then
			pcall(updateKeyEsp, entry)
		else
			destroyEntry(entry)
			keyModels[model] = nil
		end
	end

	for model, entry in pairs(monsterModels) do
		if model.Parent then
			pcall(updateMonsterEsp, entry)
		else
			destroyEntry(entry)
			monsterModels[model] = nil
		end
	end
end))

table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if processed or unloaded then
		return
	end

	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
		setEspVisible(not espOn)
	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl then
		unloadEsp()
	end
end))

task.spawn(function()
	while not unloaded do
		task.wait(0.75)
		pcall(syncEsp)
	end
end)

syncEsp()

scripts.features:
Works every game

This script was falsely deleted about 2 months ago but thanks to the owner thunder mods who helped and revived this script.


1: Aimbot (V1)

* Aimbot Toggle: On/Off the aimbot
* Keybind Mode: For pc users
* Show Floating Toggle: A Small ui for Aimbot Toggle which is draggable
* Show FOV Circle: Hide/Show circle
* FOV Circle Size: Circle Size Modifier
* Smoothness Slider: Change How hard it will lock
* Target Priority: Switch between Fov aimbot or distance aimbot (Locks onto nearest player)
* Max Auto-Aim Distance: For Distance Aimbot, modifies the range in studs of nearest player has to be to lock on
* Target Part Selection: Select a specefic part to lock on
* Team Check: Doesnt lock on player in same team
* Wall Check: Checks if player is behind something or not then when player is visible then it locks on
* Enable Specific Team Aim: Searches ur game for all teams then u can select which u teams u want to lock on or not

2: Aimbot V2 (Smart Scan)

* What it does: It Scans ur character and finds Targetable parts, many games customize their character models so use this if normal aimbot doesn't work.
* Aimbot V2 Toggle: Same as V1
* Enable Keybind V2: Same as V1
* Show Floating Toggle: Same as V1
* Show FOV Circle V2: Same as V1
* FOV Circle Size V2: Same as V1
* Smoothness V2: Same as V1
* Target Priority V2: Same as V1
* Max Distance V2: Same as V1
* Team Check V2: Same as V1
* Wall Check V2: Same as V1
* Manual Character Scanner: Scans ur entire character model
* Enable Specific Team Aim V2: Same as V1

3: ESP

* Tracers: Displays Lines on ur screen which shows the players
* Names: Shows players names
* Chams: Highlights players
* Distance (Studs): Check how far is the player
* Team Check: Doesn't esp ur own team members
* Max ESP Range: Range modifier for maximum in which players will be rendered by esp (in studs)
* Use Team Colors: Modifies all esp features by the player team color
* Team Toggles Menu: Similar to Team Specific Aimbot but in esp

4: Hitbox

* Toggle Hitbox: Turn On/Off the Hitbox
* Hitbox Size: Change the size of Hitbox
* Hitbox Transparency: Changes transparency of Hitbox
* Team Check: Does affect ur own teammates Hitbox
* Enable Team Specific: Same As Team Toggle Menu or team specefic aimbot in esp and aimbot Section

5: Configs

* Remove Autoload Config: Remove Config as autoloadr
* Enter Config Name: Modify config name
* Save Config / Overwrite Selected: Overwrite current config with ur currently active features
* Load Config: Load the config (Yeah that's it)
* Set As Autoload: Set ur config autoload, will automatically load ur config after u execute the script.
* Delete Config: Delete ur config
* Config List & Renamer Tool: Modify any Config name.

scripts.script:
if getgenv().AutoPoopCleanup then
    pcall(getgenv().AutoPoopCleanup)
    getgenv().AutoPoopCleanup = nil
end

if getgenv().AutoPoopLibrary then
    pcall(function()
        getgenv().AutoPoopLibrary:Unload()
    end)
    getgenv().AutoPoopLibrary = nil
end

local libraryUrl = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/croksyscript/CrypticLoader/refs/heads/main/Obsidian/Obsidian_UI/Obsidian_UI.lua"

local success, Library = pcall(function()
    return loadstring(game:HttpGet(libraryUrl))()
end)

if not success or not Library then
    return
end

getgenv().AutoPoopLibrary = Library

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local VirtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerScripts = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts")
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local Packets = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Packets"))
local minigameActive = PlayerScripts:WaitForChild("IS_MINIGAME_ACTIVE")

local okFood, FoodData = pcall(require, ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("FoodData"))
local okMoney, FormatMoney = pcall(require, ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("FormatMoney"))

local PoopUI = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("PoopUI")
local lineTrigger = PoopUI:WaitForChild("CatchBar"):WaitForChild("LineTrigger")
local slider = PoopUI.CatchBar:WaitForChild("BarLine"):WaitForChild("Slider")
local target = slider:WaitForChild("Target")

local BACKPACK_LIMIT = 300

local state = {
    running = true,
    notifications = {},
    remotePoop = false,
    legitPoop = false,
    instantLine = false,
    remoteDelay = 1,
    pause = 2,
    cycles = 0,
    autoSell = false,
    sellMode = "Poop Count",
    sellValue = 100,
    sellAction = "Sell All",
    sellOneMode = "First",
    lastSell = os.clock(),
    autoBuy = false,
    buyInterval = 10,
    selectedFoods = {},
    stock = {},
}

local connections = {}

local function jitter(minValue, maxValue)
    return minValue + math.random() * (maxValue - minValue)
end

local function formatMoney(value)
    if okMoney and typeof(value) == "number" then
        local ok, text = pcall(FormatMoney, value, true)
        if ok then
            return text
        end
    end
    return tostring(value)
end

local function isPoop(tool)
    return tool:IsA("Tool") and tool.Name:sub(1, 4) == "Poop"
end

local function getPoops()
    local list = {}
    for _, tool in ipairs(LocalPlayer.Backpack:GetChildren()) do
        if isPoop(tool) then
            table.insert(list, tool)
        end
    end
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local held = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    if held and isPoop(held) then
        table.insert(list, held)
    end
    return list
end

local function getBackpackSize()
    return #LocalPlayer.Backpack:GetChildren()
end

local function getWeight(tool)
    return tonumber(tool.Name:match("([%d%.]+)%s*lb")) or 0
end

local CLICK_LATENCY = 0.05

local lastCenter = 0
local lastTime = os.clock()

local function isLineInTarget()
    local now = os.clock()
    local center = lineTrigger.AbsolutePosition.X + lineTrigger.AbsoluteSize.X / 2
    local elapsed = math.max(now - lastTime, 1 / 240)
    local velocity = (center - lastCenter) / elapsed
    lastCenter = center
    lastTime = now
    local predicted = center + velocity * CLICK_LATENCY
    local margin = lineTrigger.AbsoluteSize.X * 0.065
    local left = target.AbsolutePosition.X
    return left - margin < predicted and predicted < left + target.AbsoluteSize.X + margin
end

local function sendMouse(position, down)
    VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(position.X, position.Y, 0, down, game, 0)
end

local CLICK_SPOTS = {}

for _, x in ipairs({ 0.04, 0.96, 0.08, 0.92 }) do
    for _, y in ipairs({ 0.35, 0.5, 0.25, 0.65, 0.75 }) do
        table.insert(CLICK_SPOTS, Vector2.new(x, y))
    end
end

local function isSpotFree(point)
    local inset = GuiService:GetGuiInset()
    for _, gui in ipairs(PlayerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(point.X - inset.X, point.Y - inset.Y)) do
        if not gui:IsDescendantOf(PoopUI) and (gui:IsA("GuiButton") or gui.Active) then
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end

local function getFreePoint()
    local size = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
    for _, spot in ipairs(CLICK_SPOTS) do
        local point = size * spot
        if isSpotFree(point) then
            return point
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function clickTrigger()
    local position = getFreePoint()
    if not position then
        return
    end
    sendMouse(position, true)
    task.wait(0.03)
    sendMouse(position, false)
end

local function getChargeFill()
    local chargeUi = workspace:FindFirstChild("ChargeUI")
    local bar = chargeUi and chargeUi:FindFirstChild("BarProgress", true)
    return bar and bar:FindFirstChild("Fill")
end

local function chargeBar()
    local position = getFreePoint()
    if not position then
        task.wait(1)
        return
    end
    sendMouse(position, true)
    local startTime = os.clock()
    local fill
    repeat
        task.wait()
        fill = getChargeFill()
    until fill or os.clock() - startTime > 0.5
    while os.clock() - startTime < 2 do
        if fill and fill.Parent and fill.Size.Y.Scale >= 0.97 then
            break
        end
        if not fill and os.clock() - startTime >= 0.7 then
            break
        end
        task.wait()
    end
    sendMouse(position, false)
end

local targetAspect = target:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
local defaultAspectRatio = targetAspect and targetAspect.AspectRatio
local WIDE_ASPECT_RATIO = 4

local function moveTargetToLine()
    local lineCenter = lineTrigger.AbsolutePosition.X + lineTrigger.AbsoluteSize.X / 2
    local targetCenter = target.AbsolutePosition.X + target.AbsoluteSize.X / 2
    local position = slider.Position
    slider.Position = UDim2.new(position.X.Scale, position.X.Offset + lineCenter - targetCenter, position.Y.Scale, position.Y.Offset)
end

local function widenTarget()
    if targetAspect then
        targetAspect.AspectRatio = WIDE_ASPECT_RATIO
    end
end

local function restoreTarget()
    if targetAspect then
        targetAspect.AspectRatio = defaultAspectRatio
    end
end

local function runLegitCycle()
    if not minigameActive.Value then
        chargeBar()
        task.wait(0.3)
    end
    local deadline = os.clock() + 30
    while state.running and minigameActive.Value and os.clock() < deadline do
        if state.instantLine then
            widenTarget()
            moveTargetToLine()
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            moveTargetToLine()
            clickTrigger()
            task.wait(jitter(0.2, 0.3))
        elseif isLineInTarget() then
            clickTrigger()
            task.wait(jitter(0.4, 0.55))
        end
        task.wait()
    end
    restoreTarget()
    state.cycles += 1
    task.wait(state.pause * jitter(0.85, 1.25))
end

local function runRemoteCycle()
    Packets.RequestPoop:Fire()
    state.cycles += 1
    local delay = state.remoteDelay * jitter(0.8, 1.35)
    if math.random() < 0.05 then
        delay += jitter(2, 4)
    end
    task.wait(delay)
end

local function pickPoop(mode)
    local poops = getPoops()
    if #poops == 0 then
        return nil
    end
    if mode == "Held" then
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        local held = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        return held and isPoop(held) and held or nil
    end
    if mode == "Smallest" or mode == "Biggest" then
        table.sort(poops, function(a, b)
            if mode == "Smallest" then
                return getWeight(a) < getWeight(b)
            end
            return getWeight(a) > getWeight(b)
        end)
    end
    return poops[1]
end

local function sellOne(mode)
    local tool = pickPoop(mode)
    local uuid = tool and tool:GetAttribute("uniquePoopID")
    if not uuid then
        return false
    end
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        return Packets.SellCurrentlyHeldPoop:Fire(uuid)
    end)
    if ok then
        Library:Notify("Sold poop for " .. formatMoney(result), 3)
    end
    return ok
end

local function sellAll()
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        return Packets.SellInventory:Fire()
    end)
    if ok then
        state.lastSell = os.clock()
        Library:Notify("Sold inventory for " .. formatMoney(result), 3)
    end
    return ok
end

local function runSell()
    if state.sellAction == "Sell One" then
        return sellOne(state.sellOneMode == "Held" and "First" or state.sellOneMode)
    end
    return sellAll()
end

local function refreshStock()
    pcall(function()
        Packets.FoodStock:Fire()
    end)
end

local function buyFood(name)
    pcall(function()
        Packets.PurchaseFood:Fire(name)
    end)
end

local function getFoodNames()
    local names = {}
    if okFood and typeof(FoodData) == "table" then
        for name in pairs(FoodData) do
            table.insert(names, name)
        end
        table.sort(names, function(a, b)
            return FoodData[a].Price < FoodData[b].Price
        end)
    end
    return names
end

local function getStockText()
    local names = {}
    for name in pairs(state.stock) do
        table.insert(names, name)
    end
    table.sort(names)
    return #names > 0 and table.concat(names, ", ") or "Nothing"
end

table.insert(connections, Packets.FoodStock.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(list)
    state.stock = {}
    if typeof(list) == "table" then
        for _, name in ipairs(list) do
            state.stock[name] = true
        end
    end
end))

table.insert(connections, Packets.PurchaseFood.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(purchased, name)
    if purchased then
        state.stock[name] = nil
        table.insert(state.notifications, "Bought " .. tostring(name))
    end
end))

task.spawn(function()
    while state.running do
        local hasSpace = getBackpackSize() < BACKPACK_LIMIT
        local cycle = nil
        if hasSpace and state.remotePoop then
            cycle = runRemoteCycle
        elseif state.legitPoop and (hasSpace or minigameActive.Value) then
            cycle = runLegitCycle
        end
        if cycle then
            local ok = pcall(cycle)
            if not ok then
                task.wait(1)
            end
        else
            task.wait(0.3)
        end
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while state.running do
        if state.autoSell then
            if state.sellMode == "Seconds" then
                if os.clock() - state.lastSell >= state.sellValue then
                    state.lastSell = os.clock()
                    runSell()
                end
            elseif #getPoops() >= state.sellValue then
                runSell()
                task.wait(2)
            end
        end
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while state.running do
        local text = table.remove(state.notifications, 1)
        if text then
            Library:Notify(text, 3)
        end
        task.wait(0.3)
    end
end)

local lastBuyCheck = 0

task.spawn(function()
    while state.running do
        local due = os.clock() - lastBuyCheck >= state.buyInterval
        if state.autoBuy and due and next(state.selectedFoods) then
            lastBuyCheck = os.clock()
            refreshStock()
            task.wait(1)
            for name in pairs(state.selectedFoods) do
                if state.stock[name] then
                    buyFood(name)
                    task.wait(jitter(0.5, 0.9))
                end
            end
        end
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
end)

local Window = Library:CreateWindow({
    Title = "Open Source - Poop a Big Poop",
    Footer = ".gg/XDpsSW7Ybs",
    Icon = 120217226033572,
    NotifySide = "Right",
    Center = true,
    AutoShow = true,
    ToggleKeybind = Enum.KeyCode.RightControl,
    Folder = "Poop",
})

local function buildPoopTab(Tab)
    local Box = Tab:AddGroupbox({
        Side = "Left",
        Name = "Auto Poop",
        IconName = "zap",
    })

    Box:AddToggle("RemotePoopToggle", {
        Text = "Auto Poop (Remote)",
        Default = false,
        Tooltip = "Fast, sends the poop request directly",
        Callback = function(value)
            state.remotePoop = value
            if value and Library.Toggles.LegitPoopToggle.Value then
                Library.Toggles.LegitPoopToggle:SetValue(false)
            end
        end,
    })

    Box:AddSlider("RemoteDelay", {
        Text = "Remote Delay",
        Default = 1,
        Min = 0.3,
        Max = 5,
        Rounding = 1,
        Suffix = "s",
        Tooltip = "Lower values are faster but riskier",
        Callback = function(value)
            state.remoteDelay = value
        end,
    })

    Box:AddDivider("Legit")

    Box:AddToggle("LegitPoopToggle", {
        Text = "Auto Poop (Legit)",
        Default = false,
        Tooltip = "Charges the bar and clicks the minigame like a player",
        Callback = function(value)
            state.legitPoop = value
            if value and Library.Toggles.RemotePoopToggle.Value then
                Library.Toggles.RemotePoopToggle:SetValue(false)
            end
        end,
    })

    Box:AddToggle("InstantLineToggle", {
        Text = "Instant Line",
        Default = false,
        Tooltip = "Moves the target under the line before every click",
        Callback = function(value)
            state.instantLine = value
        end,
    })

    Box:AddSlider("PoopPause", {
        Text = "Legit Pause",
        Default = 2,
        Min = 0.1,
        Max = 10,
        Rounding = 1,
        Suffix = "s",
        Callback = function(value)
            state.pause = value

    local Info = Tab:AddGroupbox({

        Name = "Info",

    local statusLabel = Info:AddLabel("Poops: 0")
    local cycleLabel = Info:AddLabel("Poops Made: 0")
    local sizeLabel = Info:AddLabel("Inventory: 0 / " .. BACKPACK_LIMIT)

    task.spawn(function()
        while state.running do
            statusLabel:SetText("Poops: " .. #getPoops())
            cycleLabel:SetText("Poops Made: " .. state.cycles)
            sizeLabel:SetText(("Inventory: %d / %d"):format(getBackpackSize(), BACKPACK_LIMIT))
            task.wait(0.5)
        end
    end)
end

local function buildSellTab(Tab)
    local Manual = Tab:AddGroupbox({
        Side = "Left",
        Name = "Manual Sell",
        IconName = "hand-coins",
    })

    Manual:AddButton({

    })

    Manual:AddDropdown("SellOneMode", {
        Text = "Sell One Mode",
        Values = { "First", "Smallest", "Biggest", "Held" },
        Default = 1,
        Callback = function(value)
            state.sellOneMode = value
        end,
    })

    Manual:AddButton({
        Text = "Sell One Poop",
        Func = function()
            if not sellOne(state.sellOneMode) then
                Library:Notify("No matching poop found", 3)
            end
        end,
    })

    local Auto = Tab:AddGroupbox({
        Side = "Right",
        Name = "Auto Sell",
        IconName = "repeat",
    })

    Auto:AddToggle("AutoSellToggle", {
        Text = "Auto Sell",
        Default = false,
        Callback = function(value)
            state.autoSell = value
            state.lastSell = os.clock()
        end,
    })

    Auto:AddDropdown("AutoSellMode", {
        Text = "Sell Trigger",
        Values = { "Poop Count", "Seconds" },
        Default = 1,
        Callback = function(value)
            state.sellMode = value
        end,
    })

    Auto:AddInput("AutoSellValue", {
        Text = "Poops or Seconds",
        Default = "100",
        Numeric = true,
        Finished = true,
        Placeholder = "100",
        Callback = function(value)
            state.sellValue = math.max(tonumber(value) or 1, 1)
        end,
    })

    Auto:AddDropdown("AutoSellAction", {
        Text = "Sell Action",
        Values = { "Sell All", "Sell One" },
        Default = 1,
        Callback = function(value)
            state.sellAction = value
        end,
    })

    Auto:AddLabel({
        Text = "Stand near the sell NPC",
        DoesWrap = true,
    })
end

local function buildFoodTab(Tab)
    local Buy = Tab:AddGroupbox({
        Side = "Left",
        Name = "Buy Food",
        IconName = "shopping-cart",
    })

    Buy:AddDropdown("FoodSelect", {
        Text = "Foods",
        Values = getFoodNames(),
        Default = {},
        Multi = true,
        AllowNull = true,
        SelectAllButtons = true,
        Callback = function(values)
            state.selectedFoods = {}
            for name, enabled in pairs(values) do
                if enabled then
                    state.selectedFoods[name] = true
                end
            end
        end,
    })

    Buy:AddButton({
        Text = "Buy Selected Once",
        Func = function()
            refreshStock()
            task.wait(1)
            for name in pairs(state.selectedFoods) do
                if state.stock[name] then
                    buyFood(name)
                    task.wait(jitter(0.5, 0.9))
                else
                    Library:Notify(name .. " is out of stock", 3)
                end
            end
        end,
    })

    Buy:AddButton({
        Text = "Buy Everything In Stock",
        Func = function()
            refreshStock()
            task.wait(1)
            for name in pairs(state.stock) do
                buyFood(name)
                task.wait(jitter(0.5, 0.9))
            end
        end,
    })

    local Auto = Tab:AddGroupbox({
        Side = "Right",
        Name = "Auto Buy",
        IconName = "repeat",
    })

    Auto:AddToggle("AutoBuyToggle", {
        Text = "Auto Buy Selected",
        Default = false,
        Callback = function(value)
            state.autoBuy = value
        end,
    })

    Auto:AddSlider("BuyInterval", {
        Text = "Check Stock Every",
        Default = 10,
        Min = 5,
        Max = 60,
        Rounding = 0,
        Suffix = "s",
        Callback = function(value)
            state.buyInterval = value
        end,
    })

    local stockLabel = Auto:AddLabel({
        Text = "In Stock: Nothing",
        DoesWrap = true,
    })

    task.spawn(function()
        while state.running do
            stockLabel:SetText("In Stock: " .. getStockText())
            task.wait(1)
        end
    end)

    refreshStock()
end

local Tabs = {
    Poop = Window:AddTab("Poop", "zap"),
    Sell = Window:AddTab("Sell", "hand-coins"),
    Food = Window:AddTab("Food", "shopping-cart"),
}

buildPoopTab(Tabs.Poop)
buildSellTab(Tabs.Sell)
buildFoodTab(Tabs.Food)

local function cleanup()
    state.running = false
    state.remotePoop = false
    state.legitPoop = false
    state.autoSell = false
    state.autoBuy = false
    restoreTarget()
    for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
        connection:Disconnect()
    end
    connections = {}
end

getgenv().AutoPoopCleanup = cleanup
Library:OnUnload(cleanup)
